facts.fact: Senegal's procurement regulator ARCOP says contracting authorities' procurement plans are entered on its APPEL (Achats publics en procedures electroniques) platform, and held a 17 November 2026 workshop on interconnecting APPEL with the budget services' SYSBUDGED, as part of its drive to generalise dematerialised procurement.

SEN.note: A workshop on linking two platforms; no law, decree or regulation on data sharing stated.
